node.title: Re: upload to PAUSE didn't seem to trigger tests
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
But I didn't receive any emails after the upload with test results. Did the tests happen silently? Or were they not triggered?

The emails only get sent on failures, [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=Graphics-Fig+v1.0.4] currently shows 187 PASSes and no failures, so you seem to be all set.

By the way, your [https://metacpan.org/source/SCOOTER/Graphics-Fig-v1.0.4|distribution] seems to contain .tar.gzs of the previous releases, which is not necessary. Update: Also, the Graphics folder appears to be duplicated, once in the root of the distribution and once in the lib folder.
